## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem, the change, and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and their results. Distinguish native runtime checks from cross-builds. Use synthetic fixtures only.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No real conversation exports, private paths, credentials, or personal contact details are included.
- [ ] The application remains local-only and preserves source files and user messages.
- [ ] Validation reports accurately describe incomplete coverage and uncertainty.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Dependency or permission changes are explained, if applicable.
